body.description: SAL, a teenage boy scavenger hero of post-collapse Texas: messy brown hair, worn leather cap with brass goggles pushed up, red bandana, tan work jacket with shearling collar, patched denim trousers, worn boots, tool pouch on belt. HD-2D diorama RPG character sprite, about 3.5 heads tall, rich hue-shifted shading, warm rim light, selective outline, detailed painterly pixel clusters. single character, full body, standing, facing the viewer, game sprite, transparent background
